items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: When I joined the band in 1936... Edgar -- Hilton Jefferson -- the two saxophone players I told you that worked with Claude Hopkins?

ctx.x: Probably just replaced him for -- but not too long, because Louie Jordan wasn't the first alto player.
See, we had Hilton Jefferson. Who's in that section there?
